bears.name: Chicago Bears
bears.summary: The biggest story is the death of Bears legend Mike Ditka, as the Hall of Fame tight end and former head coach who led the franchise to a Super Bowl championship passed away Friday morning at age 86 , prompting tributes from across the NFL and Chicago. Meanwhile, the team is dealing with injury concerns ahead of their Week 5 matchup at Green Bay, as running back Kyle Monangai was ruled out with a toe injury while quarterback Caleb Williams returned to practice Friday on a limited basis for the first time since hurting his hamstring against the Vikings .

lions.name: Detroit Lions
lions.summary: The Lions head into their Week 5 matchup against the Cardinals with injury concerns, as the team released an injury report on Friday while Tim Twentyman covered wide receiver Jameson Williams' consistency and timelines for defensive back Brian Branch and center Cade Mays' returns . Heavy on Lions also reported that Dan Campbell pushed back on talent concerns with a blunt admission and ruled out four players for the Cardinals game with a key starter in doubt .

packers.name: Green Bay Packers
packers.summary: The Packers are preparing to host their rival Chicago Bears at Lambeau Field on Sunday, with Green Bay releasing its Week 5 injury report listing DT Javon Hargrave as questionable after being added with a toe injury, among several other questionable and doubtful players. In roster moves this week, Green Bay signed RB Pierre Strong Jr.

vikings.name: Minnesota Vikings
vikings.summary: The Vikings, sitting at 4-0, are managing a crowded injury report ahead of Sunday's game at New Orleans, with left tackle Christian Darrisaw ruled out due to a concussion and starting left guard Donovan Jackson lost for the season after a torn meniscus, while receivers Justin Jefferson and Jordan Addison are questionable with ankle and hamstring injuries respectively. To bolster depth, Minnesota signed veteran receiver Odell Beckham Jr.
